rites.name: Meornum
rites.text: A rhythmic chant performed by a sea-dwelling singer that is shared as a lively tune. It is sung by a mermaid character.

rites.name: Rianirnia
rites.text: A communal chant rises from the flowers, trees, and feathered wanderers of a sun-drenched shore. It opens a gathering where the whole coastal grove joins in one lilting voice.

rites.name: Valarus Cornellus
rites.text: A tribal chant is taught by an exuberant leaper to a timid companion before the leaper departs. It teaches the companion how to carry a bold spirit.

rites.name: Seornum Coriliaria
rites.text: A mighty vocal force passed among a few chosen guardians of the savanna. It grants them a commanding power that can be shared between two bearers at a time.

rites.name: Sianalia
rites.text: A coded melody that ancient builders played to call distant star-beings, who then lent their strength to raise monumental stone structures. A reversed version of the melody sends them back again.

rites.name: Saullia
rites.text: A bouncing maneuver performed by a striped, buoyant creature who leaps in spirals. A small companion learns the move slowly, mangling its name, and later uses it to rescue a friend in peril.

rites.name: Virum Mereornium
rites.text: A haunting incantation sung by a shadowy conjurer during a moonlit rite. Its lilting refrain is said to enchant listeners and draw them under a dark spell.

rites.name: Orausor Serollus
rites.text: A chant sung by a healer and her companions to a restless boy, teaching him that stillness belongs inside him even when his voice is loud. It is shared as a gentle lesson in patience.

rites.name: Tiasornor
rites.text: A tune sung by a villager named Tesh who guides travelers through the reed-lined pools of the marsh. Its verses describe the water-paths the river beasts have worn into the land.

rites.name: Ranolles
rites.text: A short rhythmic verse that a young wanderer chants aloud while a companion keeps time by tapping on their chest on a windswept isle. It lasts only a few heartbeats.

rites.name: Telintanum Amiallum
rites.text: A tuneful verse that a frontier companion sings while searching for a fitting hopeful gift for a friend's celebration day. It is sung near a wishing spring.

rites.name: Nirnes Corauntium
rites.text: A tuneful ritual sung by a masked forager while she prepares a companion's appearance for a gathering of friends. It is performed as a lighthearted preparation before a shared feast.

rites.name: Sanor Veornes
rites.text: A chanted ruse is performed when a fallen hive swarms into a dwelling and stings anyone who enters. Companions disguise a clever friend as a hive-mother, who commands the insects to depart.

rites.name: Lentus Tantosus
rites.text: A gentle chant sung by three kin at bedtime, asking the night for calm and sweet dreams. It is a prayer carried in harmony.

rites.name: Miasus Oreornium
rites.text: A chant that scavengers raise together in the wilds to bind a wandering newcomer to their circle. It turns a lone traveler into a companion by sharing a meal and a laugh.

rites.name: Rilus Nenum
rites.text: A seafaring chant that tells of a feared sea raider, sung by a crew as they sail in search of his hidden hoard. It is first recited by an old sailor to introduce the younger crew to the story.

rites.name: Rastirnes
rites.text: A swift-footed chant sung by a lean hunter who believes that speed alone makes a traveler worthy. Her verses praise quickness above all other virtues.

rites.name: Niallantia
rites.text: A soothing chant is sung during a village gathering to calm the sleepers of the valley. It belongs to a particular tale told at the hearth.

rites.name: Rostus Niastonus
rites.text: A recurring chant sung by a small band of bakers whenever they start preparing the day's main food. A quiet instrumental version of it closes every gathering.

rites.name: Seristor Vestanum
rites.text: A ballad in which a sworn sentinel voices an aspiration to lead the royal wardens of a realm. It is sung aloud during a tale of a cursed rogue.

rites.name: Coristialus
rites.text: A tender duet sung by a proud ruler and his beloved companion, sharing their vows in a moment of quiet devotion before the wider land.

rites.name: Tolarnum
rites.text: A worker's chant that was cut from a longer tale. In it, a bound servant dreams of splitting into many selves so that the drudgery might be shared.

rites.name: Serasium
rites.text: A chant sung within a tale of wandering folk, where a sour-tempered gathering of singers unleashes a tune meant to grate on the nerves of listeners. The melody is said to be sung during a strange encounter that stirs up a comical commotion.

rites.name: Siarnes Caneornes
rites.text: A soothing chant sung by three small companions to coax a restless, bouncy friend into slumber. Its gentle melody calms the boisterous creature when night comes.

rites.name: Virones
rites.text: A soothing chant sung by a royal guardian to quiet a crying infant. Its gentle melody calms the child after a near fall.

rites.name: Seonolum
rites.text: A chant sung by a young wanderer who warns a companion about dangers glimpsed through a seeing-glass. It is offered as a reminder to protect a friend from what may come.

rites.name: Telausia Vaurnanus
rites.text: A tender chant sung by a nurturing bird-keeper who wonders whom to tend once her young have taken to the sky. It is sometimes performed in a village hall during the seasonal gathering.

rites.name: Ceones Saunornia
rites.text: A chant sung by a scholar who longs to become a true master of his craft. It expresses his wish to be recognized as a genuine expert.

rites.name: Tastor
rites.text: A chant sung by the people of a town during the opening rite of a seasonal festival honoring bees. It is performed by the whole community together.

rites.name: Oraullor
rites.text: A sly rallying chant that a cunning ruler sings with his hyena followers to stir them toward a shared scheme. It is sung in a group and recorded as a song in the Library's archives.

rites.name: Ciarum
rites.text: A dark power passes from holder to holder across many ages, each bearer gaining the mantle of a shadowed force. Its current wielder is bound to it, and the power is said to reshape anyone who takes it up.

rites.name: Rianium Ciarnausium
rites.text: A set of four carved sigils that let a bowwoman channel the forces of stone, flame, gale and frost through her weapons. Glyphs etched on foes and objects show which sigil must be invoked to open the way forward.

rites.name: Virnelum
rites.text: A soft melody sung by a gentle farm figure to rouse a sleeping friend. It is used as a cheerful way to bring someone gently back to waking.

rites.name: Reollantia
rites.text: A brief chant that a small winged courier sings during a moment of danger on a floating isle. It is shared in a tale about a crumbling sky-perch.

rites.name: Leostum
rites.text: A lulling chant shared by two rough sea-folk as they rock in their hanging nets. It is sung to ease the weary into rest during long watches.

rites.name: Veollus Orireones
rites.text: A chanted rite that calls forth a restorative power, mending torn flesh and failing organs while slowing the signs of age. It passes from teacher to student through the generations.

rites.name: Nausiarnus
rites.text: A ballad sung by two sea-rogues that recounts a hook-handed captain and the many curved hooks he keeps. It is a tune of boasting shanty verses sung in the taverns.

rites.name: Serillium Valiasenum
rites.text: A chant sung by a mother and her daughter that opens a traveling tale of two people who wish to live each other's lives for a single day.

rites.name: Amiales Sarnum
rites.text: A hurried chant performed by a nervous hare-like wanderer who rushes through a burrow. A dreamer hums it inside the hare's home before she grows suddenly large.

rites.name: Ceostalia
rites.text: A chant once meant to be sung by a bear and a panther to a young wild child. It was cut from the telling before the tale reached its listeners.

rites.name: Telornus
rites.text: A ruler sings a scheming chant while devising a plan to take vengeance and disrupt the cycle of life. The chant marks the moment his ambitions turn toward breaking the natural order.

rites.name: Lialornor
rites.text: A closing chant that a sea realm sings once its ruler lifts a long silence on song. Its voices celebrate the return of melody and mark a fresh beginning for all the people below the waves.

rites.name: Vallanum Mastus
rites.text: A chant sung by a traveling minstrel, celebrating the joy of soil and earth. It appears during a gathering held in honor of the living ground.

rites.name: Orastornia
rites.text: A tuneful chant sung by a young woman on her special day, wishing only for a quiet hour with her closest companion. It is a sweet hymn of longing.

rites.name: Valasintes
rites.text: A bonus chant once meant to open a sacred-hill tale, now a playful dance meant to mimic a woolly beast. It also appears on a memory-disc and closes with a quiet return of order.

rites.name: Cauranum Casillia
rites.text: A reflective chant sung by a trio of wanderers as they remember the day their bond was formed. It binds their companionship together through shared memory.

rites.name: Seonterium
rites.text: A soothing chant that three young companions sing together to calm a restless infant so the child will drift off to sleep.

rites.name: Cesarnia
rites.text: Two companions drink a enchanted brew that turns them into birds, and they soar together in a joyful sung moment of free flight.

rites.name: Corilorus
rites.text: A ritual chant that a parent sings to a child each year on the child's special day, passed down as a custom within a distant people.

rites.name: Valonium Amillium
rites.text: A tender motherly lullaby sung by a guardian to a crying child, promising protection and warmth. It returns near the end and during the closing credits, recalling a home the child once knew.

rites.name: Rianallor
rites.text: A cheerful melody is sung by a fleeing young maiden after a frightened run through the woods, as she gently wins over the forest creatures she meets. The tune brightens her mood and draws the timid beasts close.

rites.name: Orarnes Seraulium
rites.text: A ritual chant sung by a jealous mage who recounts being overlooked by everyone and vows to reshape the world for her own gain.

rites.name: Telernus Varnes
rites.text: A mournful performed lament is sung by a scheming sorcerer and his small companion. It voices the torn heart of a schemer caught between an old ambition and a newfound loyalty to a young princess.

rites.name: Sarnaures
rites.text: A chanted verse sung by two rival sea-thieves as a sign of trust among their crew. It opens the way aboard their vessel for those who answer it correctly.

rites.name: Siranum Coreostium
rites.text: A chant performed by a single performer who splits into copies of himself through a magic working. The copies sing together, and a small creature speaks one brief line during the performance.

rites.name: Rausillum
rites.text: A melody sung by a grieving keeper and her companion using enchanted lutes, played again and again. At its climax, the two join voices to overpower a pair of ruling sorceresses.

rites.name: Liareontus
rites.text: A morning hymn sung by two wanderers who bind a wish to the dawn. It opens a gathering and calls for a gift that will set a child's future right.

rites.name: Coralleonus
rites.text: A tune that a young man hums while mowing, is later voiced by a young woman dressing for an evening dance, and closes the story as a trio of singers together.

rites.name: Raustes
rites.text: A chanted teaching-verse that instructs learners how to multiply by five. It is taught through a sung lesson within a larger collection of counting songs.

rites.name: Nentostes
rites.text: A tuneful chant sung as a visiting herd arrives at a land of prides. It accompanies the moment a traveling procession first steps onto the shared grasslands.

rites.name: Corelum
rites.text: A communal chant sung by four young companions as they celebrate a joyful outdoor feast. It is preserved within a larger ceremonial recording that marks the gathering.

rites.name: Tirneollor
rites.text: A tuneful chant sung by a seer after a winged youth falls into a deep slumber. She must press her lips to his to rouse him from the sleep.

rites.name: Sernialanum
rites.text: A rowdy chant performed by two sea-folk companions to rouse their crew. Its clattering rhythm spreads cheer among the fleet.

rites.name: Ceornus Larnia
rites.text: A chanted sealing rite performed under a crimson sky, binding a spirit-beast into a small charm so it can no longer roam free. The song carries the words that lock the creature inside.

rites.name: Tialanum Taurialium
rites.text: A mournful chant that a lone wanderer sings during a ritual of hunting shapeshifting mimics. The verses are sung by a traveling bard inside a dim hall at a sacred gathering.

rites.name: Orentaunum
rites.text: A tainted, churning haze that a cunning dark-caster releases to twist weak-willed folk into savage, hostile beasts.

rites.name: Valastium
rites.text: A ceremonial chant sung by a young heir who vows to master the blade regardless of how grueling the drills become. It marks a determined step toward earning a place among the great duelists.

rites.name: Cosialles
rites.text: A chanted melody that a mother sings to her young child at the close of a short tale. It urges the listener to brave storms by recalling a legendary hero's courage.

rites.name: Marialles
rites.text: A chant of a cracked shell-bearer that a mourner sings to unravel tangled questions. Companions soon join the refrain together.

rites.name: Miasternus
rites.text: A charm that moves an object by borrowing the motion of another. When the caster loses hold of it, cloth and garments throughout the dwelling wake, dance wildly, and cause havoc until the spell is undone.

rites.name: Nostium
rites.text: A dramatic piece of spoken exchanges joined by a choir singing in harmony. It accompanies a violent ocean tempest.

rites.name: Tolernia
rites.text: A chanted teaching that instructs a young speaker, whose words have run dry for the day, to fall quiet and attend to the voices of those around her. It shows that listening matters as much as speaking.

rites.name: Carnes Amostus
rites.text: A song-based craft in which melodies carry hidden enchantment that shapes the world around the singer. Its sounds can awaken what lies within harmony itself.

rites.name: Vialaurnia
rites.text: A tuneful hymn of instruction once meant to teach a young apprentice about learning, though it never reached its intended form. It carries deeper significance than a simple incantation.

rites.name: Verum Aminerium
rites.text: A chanted melody sung by a human elder and a small-folk ruler, said to be a means of voicing a desire aloud. It belongs to the lore of playful spirits who dwell in the hills.

rites.name: Vanoles
rites.text: A opening chant that sea-folk voices together in a sung hymn to their deep realm. Its harmonies bind the chorus and the ruler of the waves.

rites.name: Nereolia
rites.text: A communal chant is sung when a leader calls on a gathering to shift over and welcome every member, especially a newcomer arriving at the assembly. It binds the crowd together in shared hospitality.

rites.name: Mastaunanum
rites.text: A tender melody is sung by a gentle maiden during a luminous rite. It carries the heart of affection through a single moment of blossoming light.

rites.name: Orenasia
rites.text: A winter festival song is sung by companions to persuade a reluctant ruler to join their midwinter celebration. Its lively chorus urges her to take part in the gathering.

rites.name: Solor Lestanum
rites.text: A chant sung by a wandering bard to a young scholar who wishes to match a famed mentor. It teaches that greatness can take many different forms.

rites.name: Reostelium
rites.text: Three friends perform a rhythmic dance-chant that halts carnivorous vines from spreading. The ritual is a magical countermeasure sung in unison to calm the growing snapping plants.

rites.name: Reollor Nineles
rites.text: A lingering hex is laid upon a household by an elder sorceress long before the present day. Its consequences drive a sprawling tale of wishes and woodland journeys.

rites.name: Leornestium
rites.text: A tune sung by a gentle maiden urging her small woodland companions to keep chasing their hopes, however out of reach they appear. Its message of perseverance threads through the whole tale and resounds at celebrations and quiet evenings alike.

rites.name: Meostenor
rites.text: A ballad sung by a wise night-bird as a group of companions prepare to set out on a bold journey to free a missing friend from a monstrous beast.

rites.name: Serirniasia
rites.text: A rousing oath-chant shared by a band of loyal companions who pledge to stand together. It returns at key moments, and a bard sings it one last time to close the tale.

rites.name: Tolus
rites.text: A dark chanting performed by a scheming wizard who boasts of his own greatness. It is sung as a menacing anthem in the style of a sinister rival's proclamation.

rites.name: Maullorus
rites.text: A hymn-like chant sung by a fair-skinned maiden, who lifts the spirits of companions gathered around her. It is recalled as a tune carried between a bright-eyed court and its distant gatherings.

rites.name: Laurasanum
rites.text: A form of sorcery worked through carved symbols that a practitioner uses to shape spells. It is wielded by a single young witch who draws its power from ancient script.

rites.name: Coresiarus
rites.text: A ballad sung by an ancient dark sorceress who urges a young apprentice to embrace cruelty. She promises that seizing a sacred staff will let them rule the realm together as mentor and heir.

rites.name: Amaurnes
rites.text: A joyful hymn sung by a young ruler who feels her new inner gifts awaken as her heart swells with gladness. Her happiness unknowingly stirs the magic she carries.

rites.name: Nereollum Viantillor
rites.text: A chanted anthem is sung during a fierce duel against three scheming brothers in a dark arena. Its refrain rallies the shadowy crowd to cheer the villain on.

rites.name: Reollaria
rites.text: A remembered chant that a wandering singer first shaped long ago, later echoed by a second voice on a sea-court album. It encourages people that any desire can be won through steady wanting.

rites.name: Teosantia
rites.text: A short chanted verse that a wanderer speaks just before stepping into a painted scene, which then opens into a merry gathering. In the telling it is spoken rather than sung.

rites.name: Meoles Riarnes
rites.text: A soft lullaby passed from a mother to her two children at bedtime. Its gentle melody is also sung to quiet unruly enchanted figures and restore calm to a household.

rites.name: Vileontia
rites.text: A guardian's persuasive chant warns a sheltered youth that the wide world beyond her high refuge is cruel, so she stays bound in place. The chant hides a plan to draw on the youth's glowing strands to hold back the ravages of age.

rites.name: Vanirnum
rites.text: A mournful, theatrical chant sung by a scheming sea sorceress that signals her presence and returns in a later tale, sung again by a newer voice.

rites.name: Tauntesus
rites.text: A hymn-like chant that travelers sing together during a rest at night, led by a wanderer who gathers them into a spontaneous gathering of worship.

rites.name: Mausterus
rites.text: A tender tune sung by a young investigator to coax a shy musician into playing his stringed instrument for an elderly relative. It is performed during a mystery about a ruined musical gathering.

rites.name: Taunellum
rites.text: A fifth elemental force that one of the appointed keepers of the realm holds dominion over. It flows through all living things and is shaped by the will of its guardian.

rites.name: Amiares
rites.text: A bright rising chant that a young noble sings while eager and anxious about gaining the power to soar through the air. It captures both the thrill and the nerves of a first flight.

rites.name: Telirnes
rites.text: A bouncy nonsense chant sung by a helper spirit to work a transforming enchantment. Its playful words are said to call magic into being and bring about a sudden change in someone's appearance.

rites.name: Neollosanum
rites.text: A ledger of enchanted lessons that lets a village widow learn to cast spells and call the wind from a bed-post. Her household rests uneasily beside a wandering sorcery that spills into the countryside.

rites.name: Sestia Lirium
rites.text: A soothing chant sung by a witch that lulls young listeners into a trance. Its melody and verses were crafted by a pair of composers working together.

rites.name: Valiasia
rites.text: A tender chant sung by a caretaker who shields a newly mortal hero from a shadowy underworld lord. It was first performed in a small town staging before reaching a grand city theater.

rites.name: Sistonanum
rites.text: A cheerful chant made by a bear-like woodland creature that helps young learners memorize the letters in order. It is kept as an extra piece on a disc of short stories.

rites.name: Teliarnus Noleosum
rites.text: A mournful ballad sung by a fallen ice-sorceress as she accepts that giving up her joy keeps her wild power caged. An earlier stage version repeated it after she drove her companions from her frozen hall.

rites.name: Reolliasus
rites.text: A dark chant sung by a possessed heroine who proudly claims her wicked nature. It is performed during a televised gathering in the mortal realm of a city.

rites.name: Amellinum
rites.text: A set of four deceptive apparitions conjured by a cunning trickster to advance his plots. Each one mirrors a single natural force, giving the illusion of mastery over flame and molten rock, flowing water, drifting sand, and gusting wind.

rites.name: Raurnes Valaulanum
rites.text: A mournful sung ballad, drawn from an older verse and set to new melody, that brings a wayward household member back to the hearth. It is also called the Lullaby of the Small Maiden.

rites.name: Visianus
rites.text: A small chant that travelers hum together to keep their spirits light. It is first sung during a gathering where a visiting stranger is welcomed.

rites.name: Toselles
rites.text: A chant sung by a greedy collector who schemes to turn a winged beast into a fortune of trinkets. Earlier drafts of the chant were sung more gloomily before being brightened.

rites.name: Orintum Amosor
rites.text: A melodic chant sung by a trio of traveling bards, later performed alone by a feathered wanderer to win the heart of a beloved companion. It appears within a tale of a grand contest of cunning.

rites.name: Tallus Nasus
rites.text: A ballad of hope that holds that any wish can be reached if one imagines it. It urges people to keep chasing their dreams, never abandon hope, and trust in the strength of the spirit.

rites.name: Serallirum
rites.text: A soothing chant was once meant to be hummed by a young wanderer to a dark-furred guardian at nightfall. The chant was later dropped from the telling.

rites.name: Oriasor
rites.text: A hopeful chant sung by a misshapen bell-keeper who dreams of gentle love. It stands as a counterpoint to a later dark hymn of desire, and returns in a sorrowful form when the singer's affection goes unanswered.

rites.name: Orisania
rites.text: A tender chant of a heart that refuses to admit its own longing, sung by a restless figure who keeps denying a growing affection. Chorus voices echo the denial, turning the confession into a harmony of stubborn hope.

rites.name: Rianum
rites.text: A boastful chant sung by a proud ruler who claims to outdo a rival noblewoman. It is delivered to a young visitor, flattering her while belittling another.

rites.name: Telenanum Amarentor
rites.text: A cheerful melody that a sly pair of schemers use to lure a naive wooden youth toward a glittering carnival. Its bright sound hides the danger of the temptation it represents.

rites.name: Rallum Cisaurnum
rites.text: A short sung lesson that teaches a sudden burst of feeling spoken on its own. It is one of several chanted lessons in a wider collection of teaching songs.

rites.name: Miarnes Valaunoles
rites.text: A chant sung during a night of masks and spells, heard at the start, the middle, and the close of a tale. It accompanies a sorceress who animates gourds and grave markers, and it has been voiced by a quartet and recorded by young performers.

rites.name: Orollia Tintes
rites.text: A boastful sorceress performs a bold sung challenge to a young apprentice, trying to prove she outshines his mentor. Her showy display aims to win the boy over with dazzling magic.

rites.name: Telalisum
rites.text: A melancholy tune performed by a wandering minstrel who sings of a ballad about staying hidden. The song is noted as one of the verses tied to a bard's ensemble performance.

rites.name: Seornia
rites.text: A sea-born ballad that voices a young undersea dweller's yearning for the surface world. It recurs throughout the tale as the unifying melody tied to her heart and spirit.

rites.name: Nesiarus
rites.text: A rowdy sea-chant that two rogue sailors sing together as they gather the ingredients for a seafarers' stew. Its lively refrain is shared among crews at sea.

rites.name: Contasia
rites.text: A chant of gathering that a singer releases into the open air, reshaping an older charm of transformation into a sung promise. It is offered as a thread carried forward from a much earlier rite.

rites.name: Sereolor Rasontum
rites.text: A ceremonial chant accompanies a young pilot donning a gleaming armored harness before launching into the sky. A brief version is sung during the ritual, while a longer form circulates widely among followers.

rites.name: Amostium
rites.text: A sung performance in which a young character describes a magical sparkling charm to two friends, so they can reshape the theme of a celebration.

rites.name: Amantes Vauntarium
rites.text: A chanted recital that rings out when a dreamer steps into a schoolroom's chalk-marked wall. It marks the moment the lesson begins within a waking nightmare.

rites.name: Vantum
rites.text: A melodic chant performed by a broadcasting entity and its two young companions during a public introduction. It serves as an emotional anthem announcing a digital persona to an audience.

rites.name: Taustor
rites.text: A brief performed song is sung by a duplicate of a clever young scholar within a cross-dimensional adventure. It serves as a moment where the character explains a situation to others.

rites.name: Oresallor
rites.text: A wordless vocal improvisation built on a festive tune sung by a father and young son in a holiday tale. Performers invent nonsense syllables to echo the melody.

rites.name: Oraullium
rites.text: A soft sleep-song played as a recorded piece on an old collection of tunes. It is sung to coax the night sky into quiet and to lull listeners toward rest.

rites.name: Rastus
rites.text: A mind wanders away from the present moment into imagined scenes. The wandering lets a person picture unseen places and rehearse what might come next.

rites.name: Costanum
rites.text: A tune sung by a young prince and his schoolmates while a bewitching charm holds him. It briefly leads its listener to wonder whether the enchantment has gone too far, and it returns later when a proposal is made.

rites.name: Rosiarnum
rites.text: A tuneful performance given by a sea-born heroine within a broadcast tale, sung by her voice to a courageous gathering. The melody rallies her to embrace a bold spirit.

rites.name: Oriallasum
rites.text: A performer sings a rhythmic chant while several companions climb a towering wall of stone. The song encourages them to keep their grip and never lose their footing.

rites.name: Ciarnasium
rites.text: A speaking art that shapes sound with the inner cheek instead of the throat. Its most famous voice belongs to a quarrelsome feathered trickster known across the kingdoms.

rites.name: Reostanes
rites.text: A nightly spectacle of bursting lights and painted projections rises from a tall tower and spreads down a long avenue. Familiar melodies accompany the glowing displays, which return only for limited stretches of time.

rites.name: Misum Corostum
rites.text: A chanted song in which a lonely caster wishes for a twin self, so that every promise owed to loved ones can finally be kept at once.

rites.name: Miarnes
rites.text: A tuneful lesson teaches how the body's inner rivers carry blood through a looping network of vessels. It is shared as a catchy chant meant to help listeners remember the workings of the heart and its channels.

rites.name: Valiasintum
rites.text: A tune a performer sings to coax a reluctant partner into joining a stage act of illusions. The persuasion attempt fails in the end.

rites.name: Valauses
rites.text: A cheerful chant teaches that anyone can care for the living world through small daily acts, such as conserving power and sorting waste. It is shared among a group of young friends and their guide.

rites.name: Seroles Teleontilor
rites.text: A bright melody performed by a single singer that expresses a sudden surge of elation. It appears within a longer televised celebration.

rites.name: Cinium
rites.text: A two-part ballad sung by a restless heroine as her day turns sour, then again the next morning after her heartfelt wish is granted. It briefly echoes an older tune about an enchanted feast.

rites.name: Telarianes
rites.text: A closing chant performed by two voices as a shape-changing rite nears its end. Listeners say it marks the moment a bound figure is freed from its old form.

rites.name: Oriases
rites.text: A bright performed chant that a coiling sea-witch sings to explain why the garments of her hidden coastal people are dazzling. It is shared with a gathered crowd of kin and companions.

rites.name: Selarnum
rites.text: A communal chant sung at a school rally, where a mixed gathering of beings celebrates their combined strength and grows stronger by standing together.

rites.name: Renoses
rites.text: A bright, looping melody that a band of feline performers sings together to close a story. It is passed along by voices that each take a turn at the chorus.

rites.name: Cornanum
rites.text: A tender little chant that two plush companions share after a fall, reminding each other that every friend stumbles now and then. It is sung to soothe hurt feelings that linger after a rough moment.

rites.name: Oristeornum
rites.text: A gentle tune in which two companions urge a restless friend to set down worries and savor slow pleasures like climbing high branches and drifting cloud watching. The friend soon bolts off once the melody fades.

rites.name: Rianarium
rites.text: A bold, defiant spellcaster who rebels against the rules of her craft. She takes a newcomer from another realm under her wing as an apprentice and teaches her the art of magic.

rites.name: Telanum Rentiasor
rites.text: A chanted phrase used in meditation that inspired a wandering devotee movement, whose followers wore shaven heads and robes. It also became a comic stock answer among travelers who claim to be lost.

rites.name: Resor
rites.text: A cheerful duet sung by a scheming inventor and his newfound companion, expressing affection in the middle of a plot. It is performed during a dinner scene.

rites.name: Corernanum Amaranum
rites.text: A cheerful chant two young friends share to calm a flare of anger. One offers the other a method of replacing a storm of feelings with gentler, pleasant memories.

rites.name: Ceostolles
rites.text: A tune sung by a scheming green creature in a comedy caper. It is sometimes shown in a music video and appears as a bonus track.

rites.name: Mallernum
rites.text: A melodic chant that accompanies a supple heroine whenever she stretches into action. It serves as her personal anthem, sung in the rising tone of a returning champion.

rites.name: Neostiales
rites.text: A tune sung by a tinkerer while finishing a music box, about how fleeting moments remain alive within the heart. A young woman later returns to it when a magical book carries her back to her childhood home, and a famed singer performs it again at the close of the tale.

rites.name: Corollor
rites.text: A lively dance-chant that blends rustic stomping rhythms with street-beat chanting. Crowds learn its steps through a patterned line formation, and it spread widely through many lands.

rites.name: Seraulum Telileornes
rites.text: A chanted warning that overindulging in one sweet grain blend leaves a person dizzy and grinning. A sly, striped trickster sings it to a young visitor.

rites.name: Lesastor
rites.text: A melodic tune that a young healer sings to comfort a companion. It is shared during a story where a gentle helper offers reassurance to someone who feels alone.

rites.name: Salor Rirestum
rites.text: A tenth communal chant sung by a mistaken-identity host and a group of pupils, a warning shared among a teacher and her students in a modern school hall.

rites.name: Ameolus Lauseolia
rites.text: A bard-hymn sung by a chorus of men, asking where a silenced friend's lost speech has wandered off to. It is set in the search for voices lost to an illness of the throat.

rites.name: Nintesia
rites.text: A jesting chant is sung by four companions during a tale of a cursed ferry hound. It is a tune about a playful trick, performed in the middle of the story's drama.

rites.name: Coriasontor
rites.text: A bright performance in which one voice describes an effortless, carefree stretch of life while another voice describes a grueling, troubled one. The two contrasting accounts unfold together in a single musical number.

rites.name: Corirentes
rites.text: A tender serenade sung by a lovestruck firefly to his beloved, and later shared as a love song between two young lovers. It carries the sweetness of devotion across the valley.

rites.name: Teontaurnum
rites.text: A soft sung melody that carries sleepers into a dreamy realm where no place is fixed. It was woven by two makers who gave it words and tune.

rites.name: Valilaunum
rites.text: A boundless, neutral force of wonder that anyone may wield for good or ill. Some beings are bound by an unseen power to channel it toward kindness and the protection of living growing things.

rites.name: Tintellor Mollum
rites.text: A mournful rhythmic chant is sung by a lone traveler while woodland creatures join in a grand, swaying display. It recalls the bold, glossy style of an earlier era.

rites.name: Teleoserium
rites.text: A joyful communal chant sung by three companions and a village chorus at the opening of a traveling puppet troupe's tale, then echoed by everyone at the close. It celebrates the simple gladness of ordinary days.

rites.name: Noneolium
rites.text: A reflective chant sung by a young heroine as she retraces the steps of an experiment, examining what made a sweet creation turn out so well. It is performed in the style of a musical piece about careful discovery.

rites.name: Ceosiantus
rites.text: A boastful tune sung by a scheming villain as he reveals his wicked plan. It is a darker remix of a cheerful song that once belonged to a brighter tune.

rites.name: Telanosium
rites.text: A tune that opens a sprawling tale of buried riches, sung at the start to set the mood for the journey ahead.

rites.name: Sistellanum
rites.text: A gifted sorceress who draws her arts from a mutant gift and wields them with great skill. She is the younger sister of a steel-skinned guardian.

rites.name: Tastor Ameosilus
rites.text: A sung chant performed by a flustered winged helper who explains that earning her wings requires granting one person's cherished wish. Her repeated efforts keep ending in mishaps.

rites.name: Vaullasor
rites.text: A melodic chant that a lone wild huntress raises to declare her independence from the pack. Its refrain is delivered in her own voice and carries her defiant spirit.

rites.name: Coraunanum
rites.text: A gentle tune that a healer hums at the start of a night gathering, and later a trio of companions sings it again near the close. It is shared among the people of a small hearthside village.

rites.name: Cantum Corestanum
rites.text: A tuneful verse that a young bat-blooded girl shares with her companion to show that loved ones are cherished even when they are unruly. Several friends and kin join in the singing.

rites.name: Ristia
rites.text: A tune taught in a classroom that a group sings together, sparking a teacher to form them into a choir. It is performed by two singers in a film's soundtrack.

rites.name: Nausintum
rites.text: A rowdy anthem that a band of wanderers sings to celebrate the thrill of arriving somewhere wild. It later echoes through a thundering sky-hero's adventure, lending the scene its energy.

rites.name: Noliarnia
rites.text: A dark, hushed chant sung by two voices, offered as a plea for protection from a distant pair of wanderers who record it for a royal hall's keeping.

rites.name: Lirausor
rites.text: A bold chant sung by a bearded lecturer, built to mimic the restless pounding of a brand-new style of music. Its rhythm was later borrowed for a short promotional tune.

rites.name: Siasenium
rites.text: A melodic hymn sung by a bright vocalist as the closing chant of a traveling animated tale. It is sung over the final stretch of the story's ending.

rites.name: Oreranum Nantor
rites.text: A bold little hymn sung by two companions as they set out on a journey, one urging the other to find courage in their small frame.

rites.name: Mialaranum
rites.text: A rallying chant sung by a mother who drives a crowd to demand a political voice. It opens the tale, announcing the restless spirit of the people who seek equal rights.

rites.name: Corantia Tarnesia
rites.text: A bright hymn-like tune that teaches listeners how sunlight can be gathered and shared as a power for ordinary folk. It is sung by a traveling sky-messenger who carries the idea across the land.

rites.name: Viarnilanum
rites.text: A mournful chant that teaches young learners how to keep power from being wasted. It is the only chant of its kind and returns later in a gentler reprise.

rites.name: Sintes Serallor
rites.text: A chant that explains how the inner frame of a living being breaks down its meals. It is sung in a teaching hall to help young listeners learn the process.

rites.name: Rallontum
rites.text: A young traveler sings a shared song after realizing she could never leave her kin behind, and her companions join in. The chorus is briefly broken by spoken words in one telling, yet runs clean in another.

rites.name: Reontia Amaneostor
rites.text: A tune composed by a traveling musician after a festive shoreside feast. It appears in a group singing recording filmed at a seaside gathering.

rites.name: Amontia Oriallia
rites.text: A chanted melody that opens a set of short teaching films about the workings of the world. A small insect-like guide sings it to introduce each lesson.

rites.name: Masiaror
rites.text: A bedtime musical medley performed during a grand overnight gathering. It blends several soothing tunes into one lullaby sung by the gathered companions.

rites.name: Teliantanum Telianor
rites.text: A melody performed during a traveling celebration, sung by a sea-born guide who reassures a young royal that hope remains after a failed rescue. She is encouraged to seek help from a wise companion.

rites.name: Serorum Nantes
rites.text: A chanting verse that grows longer as each new line stacks onto the last. It is sung in a short animated film made in the mid-twentieth century.

rites.name: Colinia
rites.text: A chanted hymn sung across a great pleasure grounds during its jubilee festival. Later, its melody is sold as a single recording through traders' shops.

rites.name: Ceostum Serellostia
rites.text: A glowing sound recording marks the revival of a nighttime street procession of lights and music at a grand fantasy park. The recording is no longer produced.

rites.name: Vilor
rites.text: A small mirthful gust-spectacle that a lone prankster-figure performs. It is recorded as a short-form performance staged in the modern age.

rites.name: Centosium
rites.text: A catchy tune performed at the close of a celebration on a broadcast stage. It lulls small mischievous goblin-like creatures into a deep sleep.

rites.name: Serium Amontes
rites.text: A tuneful whistled chant that a shy performer rehearses on a grand hall's stage. Its melody later returns in a background score as a gentle encouragement to discover one's gift.

rites.name: Amausanum Serores
rites.text: A short chanted ritual sung when a band of seekers is stumped, as they tap their brows and scan colorful surroundings for clues. Its refrain is sometimes altered to mark a seasonal festival.

rites.name: Amesistor
rites.text: A ditty sung by a shadowy creature that lives beneath a sleeping place, explaining the necessary provisions for a dweller who must move into a fresh hiding spot. Several companions join in the chorus.

rites.name: Corollia Mantonia
rites.text: A tune performed by a young sorceress who longs to become a powerful enchanter like her mother and father. It is sung within a story about a small magic-user.

rites.name: Orastor Cestus
rites.text: A melodic chant that a guide voices repeatedly throughout a long journey of recurring trials. In one special gathering, two travelers sing it together as a shared duet.

rites.name: Cinus Oresum
rites.text: A magical field that halts the flow of time within its reach, leaving everything inside it suspended outside the ordinary passage of moments.
